siteNote: Gate every new explainer row to this unit and later with a DICTS_UNIT_ORDER = 5 constant, the way Unit 4 used LISTS_UNIT_ORDER, and prove with a test that Units 1-4 keep exactly their old kinds. reviewFocus: (1) as "starting-from-zero": Lesson 4A from the start — make the class's slips: {name: "Lucky"} with an unquoted key, "name" = "Lucky" inside { }, a values-only sheet, "Max_Mana" for "max_mana" (KeyError), hero.mana with a dot, hero("mana") with round brackets, a missing colon or comma in the literal; judge every message and Help rung, and whether 'keys keep their quotes' survives every message; (2) as "right shape, wrong meaning": hero["mana"] = 7 typed instead of hero["mana"] - cost, book["spell_name"] instead of book[spell_name], `2 in book` expecting True for a value, skipping a level (hero["wisdom"] instead of hero["abilities"]["wisdom"]) and going one level too deep, roster["Gearshift"] instead of roster[1]["name"]; (3) as "steady with a template": the is-it-in and can-they-cast scaffolds, and Project 4P "Mar'tu's Ledger of Heroes" from its start; (4) as "ready to stretch": take a Quick Check 4 form end to end (write inside a card, the guard-then-store, the get-compare-act chain with exactly-enough) plus the optional "The Barrier, From Blank" challenge and Lucky's side quest, and judge whether it is an honest fast path.
